title: COCO-Urdu: A Large-Scale Urdu Image–Caption Dataset with Multimodal Quality Estimation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality, semantic consistency, and visual grounding of zero-shot translated Urdu image captions using a hybrid multimodal Quality Estimation (QE) framework (incorporating COMET-Kiwi, BERTScore, and CLIPScore) to create a high-fidelity dataset aimed at mitigating cross-lingual performance disparities in vision-language models.
